caption: The drawing depicts a large ceramic jar positioned centrally on a flat, wooden surface, with the jar occupying most of the vertical space in the composition. The jar is conical in shape, wider at the top and tapering toward the base, with a thick rim at the top edge. Its surface exhibits a mix of earthy colors, predominantly various shades of brown, orange, and tan, with dark patches and irregular color gradients suggesting natural glaze patterns. There is visible texture detailing on the jar, including fine lines indicating wear or natural imperfections. The wooden surface beneath the jar is rendered with a horizontal grain pattern and bordered by a slightly darker line, delineating its edge. Above the jar, the text "JAR ~ EARLY 19th CENTURY" is written in uppercase serif letters, centered near the top edge of the paper. The background is plain and light in color, providing contrast to both the jar and the wooden surface.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
